Evaluation of a suggestion produced by prepareSuggestion

Source: R/prepareSuggestion.R
evalSuggestion.Rd

Computes the partition of the frame implied by one of the two chromosomes returned by prepareSuggestion, using the same rule as strataGenalg2(), and the corresponding Bethel sample size in each domain. Useful to check the seeds before running the genetic algorithm, and to compare them with its final solution.

The strata are built with buildStrataDF, i.e. without the prediction variance and the spatial correlation used by method = "spatial": for frames of the spatial method the sample sizes are lower than those of the spatial optimisation and only indicative.

evalSuggestion(frame, errors, sugg, which = 1, minnumstr = 2)

Arguments

frame

The sampling frame used to build sugg (see prepareSuggestion).

errors

Data frame of precision constraints (columns DOM, CV1, CV2, ..., domainvalue), as required by optimStrata.

sugg

Data frame returned by prepareSuggestion.

which

Chromosome to evaluate: 1 (column suggestions1) or 2 (column suggestions2).

minnumstr

Minimum number of units allocated to each stratum (passed to bethel as minnumstrat). Default 2.

Value

A data frame with one row per domain and columns domainvalue, strata_requested (H), strata_nonempty (number of non-empty strata produced by the chromosome) and n (Bethel sample size, rounded to one decimal).

See also

prepareSuggestion, bethel

Examples

data(iris)
iris$id <- seq_len(nrow(iris))
frame <- buildFrameDF(df = iris, id = "id",
                      X = c("Petal.Length", "Petal.Width", "Sepal.Width"),
                      Y = c("Sepal.Length", "Petal.Length"),
                      domainvalue = "Species")
errors <- data.frame(DOM = "DOM1", CV1 = 0.02, CV2 = 0.03, domainvalue = 1:3)
set.seed(1234)    # the seed "kmeans1d" uses stats::kmeans()
sugg <- prepareSuggestion(frame, nStrata = 3, active = c("X1", "X2"))
evalSuggestion(frame, errors, sugg, which = 1)
#>   domainvalue strata_requested strata_nonempty    n
#> 1           1                3               3  7.9
#> 2           2                3               3  8.9
#> 3           3                3               3 12.5
evalSuggestion(frame, errors, sugg, which = 2)
#>   domainvalue strata_requested strata_nonempty    n
#> 1           1                3               3 10.7
#> 2           2                3               3  7.7
#> 3           3                3               3  7.4
